_stamp: [2026-10-17 07:44 PM Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-0.121 S121-J2 — runtime schema of ONE journal row (R-JOURNAL v1.1 R-JN-12…18, doc 72 §3). 1.0.0 lived only in PHASE-0.100 doc 92 §2; 1.1.0 is additive: state, summary, original.doc_code, origin, error, mirror, learning. Read by BizCity_Journal_Index (site) and by plugins through bizcity_journal_record().
rule: R-JOURNAL (docs/rules/PHASE-0-RULE-JOURNAL.md) — every bookkeeping need of every business flow, entry point and plugin is ONE row here; Sheet / CSV / web / KG are layers around it, never a second ledger.

summary.note: 1-3 sentences for people and for the cell registry; '' when nobody wrote one (then title stands in)

doc_date.note: date ON the document, not the capture date

rules: failed = no original kept (R-JN-14, Q121-13) and error.code is set
verified is set by a PERSON (flags.verified.by = WP user id), never by a model
void = removed from the register; the row stays (history)

card.note: fields declared by the kind's card_fields

original.note: R-JN-2 immutable; every document row must carry doc_code + sha256

source_type.note: closed set (R-JN-19); unknown ⇒ plugin. PHASE-0.124: group_capture = tệp nhóm Zalo (R-JN-27), group_brief = sổ ghi chép nhóm

source_ref.note: doc_code for documents; <table>:<id> for a pointer row

learning.note: R-JN-20 four learning levels; L3 never automatic. allowed = the kind's learn (none | index | vector | graph) — none: a ledger row is never embedded or graphed.

mirror.note: R-JN-15 the Sheet mirror is written AFTER this row exists · v1.4 (R-JN-23, PHASE-0.117 doc 67, 2026-10-18): default off; pending only while an export runs or when the person turned the standing mirror on — a Sheet is an EXPORT of the journal, never the place a record is made

ref_code.note: v1.4 (R-JN-25) + 1.2.0: the code a person reads and types back; prefix by kind (journal-kinds@1.3 ref_codes): fin.cash TC · fin.debt CN · task.progress TD · task.todo VC · fin.plan KH · documents TL (file code) · job.run JB · job.evidence EV · brain.notebook NB · sheet.define SO · skill.* KN · otherwise JE-<entry_id>; display / recall only — the key stays entry_id + idempotency_key

derived_from.note: R-JN-10 products point at their sources

layer.note: the BrainLedger mode a row belongs to

tier.note: maturity of DOCUMENT KNOWLEDGE only (layer document / notebook): graph_state done ⇒ L3 · embedded_at ⇒ L2 · else L1; null for twin_sheet / skill / job / output (doc 05 §4, D126-1). learning.level stays.

audience.note: projection of the customer switch: off ⇒ owner, view / download ⇒ customer

access.note: brain-access@1 row grants. customer is set by a PERSON (REST PATCH), never MCP; a sensitive row refuses it (audience_locked). delivered_to is written when a product is delivered to a customer (BS-7).

belongs.note: one place for the matrix columns Notebook · Nhóm · Liên hệ (no new SQL column)

version.note: R-FILE-VERSION: one row per version; `of` (count) is computed by GET journal/versions, never stored

job.note: present on every row written inside a job; the site also stamps the tag jb-<header id>

projection.doc-register@1: BizCity_Journal_Index::register_row( $entry ) — one flat row for Sheet (sheet-ledger@1 docs_v1) / CSV / web; never carries URLs, hashes, phones, uids
